DETERMINATION

Pinnacle Health Plan has completed review of the above inpatient admission and has issued an adverse determination based on medical necessity. Benefits for the inpatient level of care billed under DRG 872 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] are denied. This adverse determination is a medical necessity determination and is described as such throughout this notice.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

Review was conducted using the InterQual-style criteria set applied by this plan for acute inpatient admission. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

Criteria findings:

SEP-01: Laboratory and vital sign findings did not show sepsis with persistent instability after initial treatment.

SEP-02: Blood pressure responded to initial fluids without persistent hypotension.

No other criteria codes were applied to this determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes will appear on the remittance advice associated with claim CLM77189037824:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

The member, or a provider acting as the member's authorized representative, may request a Level 1 appeal of this adverse determination. The appeal may be submitted by letter to the Utilization Management Appeals Unit or by document upload through the secure provider or member portal.

The appeal submission should cite the criteria codes inline, specifically SEP-01 and SEP-02, and should state the basis on which each finding is disputed. Please attach the History and Physical and all progress notes for the admission under review. Written argument is subject to a five page limit, exclusive of attached medical records.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that time may not be eligible for Level 1 review.

A copy of the criteria applied in this review is available on request at no charge. A clinical peer reviewer is available to discuss this adverse determination with the treating provider upon request through the Utilization Management Department.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
